description: Get the price to CNC machine a part in the US. KinetiCAD's engine plans how the part is machined (the machine, the setups, the tools and the cycle time), and the price is the setup time and the machine time at a US shop rate, plus the material. Returns the unit price for the quantity, the cost lines, the plan and the delivery date. Planning a new part takes from about 10 seconds to a few minutes: if status is planning, call again after retry_after_seconds. Prices are in US dollars.

material.description: What the part is machined from.

part_id.description: The part_id that build_part (or the HTTP upload of a STEP file) returned.

name: price_part
title: Price a part
